data.name: Telekinetic Deflection
data.description: Element aether; Type utility (Sp); Level 8; Burn 0 You can deflect your foes' attacks, as the spell deflectionAPG with a duration of 1 round. You can accept 1 point of burn to increase the duration to 1 round per kineticist level you possess.
